survivors.locator: Article I — Of Faith in the Holy Trinity
survivors.phrase: three persons, of one substance, power, and eternity—the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost
survivors.rationale: Directly attributes shared power and eternity of the Godhead to the Holy Ghost as one of the three co-equal persons.
survivors.chunk_text: There is but one living and true God, everlasting, without body or parts, of infinite power, wisdom, and goodness; the maker and preserver of all things, both visible and invisible. And in unity of this Godhead there are three persons, of one substance, power, and eternity—the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost.

survivors.phrase: Holy Spirit, distinct but inseparable, eternally one in essence and power
survivors.rationale: Asserts that Father, Son, and Holy Spirit are eternally one in essence and power, attributing eternal power to the Spirit.
survivors.chunk_text: We believe in the one true, holy and living God, Eternal Spirit, who is Creator, Sovereign and Preserver of all things visible and invisible. He is infinite in power, wisdom, justice, goodness and love, and rules with gracious regard for the well-being and salvation of men, to the glory of his name. We believe the one God reveals himself as the Trinity: Father, Son and Holy Spirit, distinct but inseparable, eternally one in essence and power.

survivors.locator: Article 1. Faith in the Holy Trinity, ¶210
survivors.phrase: one essential nature, power and eternity — the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit
survivors.rationale: Asserts the Holy Spirit shares one essential nature, power, and eternity with the Father and Son, affirming divine eternal power.
survivors.chunk_text: We believe in the one living and true God, both holy and loving, eternal, unlimited in power, wisdom and goodness, the Creator and Preserver of all things. Within this unity there are three persons of one essential nature, power and eternity — the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.

survivors.locator: Articles of Religion, Article IV - Of the Holy Ghost
survivors.rationale: Asserts the Holy Ghost's eternal divine nature, from which eternal power and might can be inferred, though the exact terms 'power' and 'might' are not used.
survivors.chunk_text: The Holy Ghost, proceeding from the Father and the Son, is of one substance, majesty, and glory with the Father and the Son, very and eternal God.

survivors.chunk_text: We believe in the Holy Spirit who proceeds from the Father and the Son, and is of the same essential nature, majesty, and glory, as the Father and the Son, truly and eternally God. He is the Administrator of grace to all, and is particularly the effective Agent in conviction for sin, in regeneration, in sanctification, and in glorification. He is ever present, assuring, preserving, guiding, and enabling the believer.
